title: v1.3.2
description:
New in this version: 
* Several fixes for bugs arising from NABSA's update to the gbfs spec (1.1-RC)
* Improved error message for multiple cities matching the supplied string
* Accomodate valid json URLs with no .json file extension

title: version 1.3.1
description: Addresses a unit test error on CRAN's `r-patched-solaris-x86` server--all package functions requiring internet access now immediately check the internet connection upon being called, raising a message and returning an empty list if an internet connection is not available.

title: add testing coverage
description: add testing coverage for the package using `testthat`, as well as some edits to utility functions based on things that came up while writing tests. :-)

title: add get_gbfs_cities fn
description: Great package! Just thought this might make usage a bit easier by allowing direct extraction of all cities. Otherwise the user really has no direct way to find out themselves which cities might work in `get_gbfs()`. Probably also good to add a note to documentation of the latter suggesting that list of all cities can be obtained from `get_gbfs_cities()`.
